newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold exchange volume surges, prices up.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold exchange volume surges, prices up.

text.p: Both volume and prices rose on the Istanbul gold exchange on Monday, after weekend jewellery sales were boosted by new year demand, dealers said.
Volume surged to 855 kilos from only 87 kilos on Friday.

Gold closed at $370.00 an ounce, up from Thursday's $369.50. There was no dollar terms trade on Friday. In lira terms, gold ended at 1,289,500 lira per gram, up from Friday's 1,283,600 in line with the lira's easing against the dollar.
The Turkish lira eased to 108,020 to the dollar from 107,450 at Friday's close.
There was 810 kilos of trade in the morning session and only 45 kilos in the afternoon, 52 percent of the total turnover was in lira terms.
